prohibited_inference: No module-specific genomic architecture or genotype-phenotype claim is authorized by this pilot.

flow_cytometry_gate.boundary: 2C is a reference-bias QC covariate/stratifier, not a capitulum-causality result.

hard_stop: Do not sequence the full 298-individual Phase-A panel, and do not choose C. sieboldii Nature-test individuals, before Gate CS and this transferability pilot are classified.
green_action: Retain existing public references for Phase-A/Tier-2 discovery; do not build a focal reference merely for completeness.
amber_action: Build focal C. sieboldii HiFi + chromosome-scale reference before Nature Fig.3 local-history inference.
red_action: Focal reference mandatory; escalate to mini-pangenome/graph if focal-form reference bias persists.

sample_selection_gate.allowed_before_gate: reference-transferability-only sequencing of already authorized samples
sample_selection_gate.amber_rule: If CS_AMBER, do not treat the 8-individual WGS as a natural-reassembly test; verify an alternative focal system.
